title: Safe Average
description:
Write a function `safe_average(readings)` that computes the float average of a list of numbers.
If the list is empty, safely return `0.0` to avoid zero-division errors.

hidden_tests.kind: an empty list of sensor readings

hints: Averaging requires dividing by the number of elements, which is undefined when empty.
Examine what happens when len(readings) is zero: Python will raise ZeroDivisionError.
You must guard against an empty list before computing the division.
Add an initial check: if len(readings) == 0, return 0.0 immediately.
